geometry_c16_k1_r1_v1.reason: C16/K1/R1 static CBs collide with required common-head input and two simultaneously live sharded chunk outputs at the fixed full-stack resident/norm contract.
geometry_c16_k1_r1_v1.control_result: Both alternating and serial-trace lifecycles fail identically before candidate eager completion. Serial retry releases the baseline trace and output before candidate allocation; this refutes retained-baseline-trace interference.

source_evidence.finding: The output local retains the first sharded chunk until the second linear call returns. Both 64-tile BF16 output shards coexist.
--serial-traces releases baseline trace/output before candidate eager, leaving the same frozen norm and resident allocation.

geometry_c16_k1_r1_v1.scope: Exact frozen real-hidden common-head geometry family; no kernel/lifecycle rewrite or lower resident policy was tested.
